title: Haruki Murakami: 'Writing struck me completely unexpectedly, like a lightning bolt from a clear sky'
subhead: In an interview, the Japanese writer recalls how, from being a passionate reader, he suddenly became a creator one day in April 1978. Sometimes worn down by critics, the author believes it is very difficult to persevere in literature.

title: Spanish Civil War: 'How I found my Republican great-grandfather, forgotten in mass graves'
